title: Newsletter DigestArticle records discard summary metadata

evidence.quote:
if newsletter_articles and newsletter_mode == "summarize":
...
result = ExtractedArticle(
...
is_summary=True,
                                ai_failed=False,

record = DigestArticle(
                    digest_id=self.digest_id,
                    feed_id=self._get_synthetic_feed_id("newsletter"),
                    title=article.title,
                    url=article.url,
                    mode="raw",
                    word_count=article.word_count,
                    ai_failed=False,

reasoning: Newsletter articles can be summarized and represented as ExtractedArticle(is_summary=True), but _save_newsletter_article_records always persists mode="raw" and ai_failed=False. The EPUB receives the summarized content, while the persisted DigestArticle audit/client-sync metadata says it is raw, creating inconsistent API data for the same article.
recommendation: Persist newsletter mode and ai_failed from the ExtractedArticle, matching the RSS and media save paths: mode should be summarized when article.is_summary is true, and ai_failed should use article.ai_failed.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests verify DigestArticle fields for summarized newsletter content.
suggestedRegressionTest: Run newsletter enrichment with newsletter_mode="summarize" and a successful LLM summary, then assert the saved DigestArticle has mode="summarized" and ai_failed=false.
